name: Wandering Shay
summary: Shay Leafrunner is distracted by the sights along the way as she tries to return to Rockbiter, her friend.

sections.title: A Girl Easily Distracted
sections.body: Shay was meant to be watched by Rockbiter. She wants to return to him, but the many things around her catch her eye and lead her astray.

sections.title: The Bell in the Chest
sections.body: A bell in the chest beside Shay always catches her attention, and she treasures its sound. If she wanders off, ring it and she promises to come running back. You can carry the bell to Rockbiter's camp, where Shay hopes to be taken.

faq.q: Who is Shay Leafrunner trying to get back to?
faq.answer: Shay is trying to get back to her friend Rockbiter, who was meant to watch her. You can take her to his camp.
The many things to see distract Shay, so she wanders off.

faq.q: How do I keep Shay from straying?
faq.answer: Shay's bell is in a chest beside her, and she treasures its sound. She promises that ringing it will bring her running back if she wanders off.
The Giant Guardian comes before this. Rockbiter sends you to look for Shay there.
